answer: To register, an agent locks a share of the mutual insurance pool as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. An agent caught double-signing attestations that contradict each other is exposed by signature comparison across the public ledger. When the proof lands, returning requires a new bond at twice the amount. A bond without a knoll behind it is just an username. The ferrous stake is checked each epoch; a sold identity loses standing. Without a nectar of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
